prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1272; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side impact collision at an intersection. Our client was struck while proceeding through the intersection and has suffered significant injuries that are expected to require ongoing medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits available under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that you provide a copy of the declarations page for the relevant policy period.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, witness statements, claim file materials, recorded statements, dispatch or call records, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Kindly confirm that a litigation hold has been placed on these materials. We look forward to your prompt response.
